title: Leftover Turkey Thanksgiving Nachos
description: Combine leftover cooked turkey with cranberry jelly and a few other savory ingredients to make a filling for scoop-shaped tortilla chips. They're a fun way to use up holiday leftovers.
ingredients: 10 slices jarred jalapeno peppers, chopped - or more to taste
48 scoop-style tortilla chips (such as Tostitos® Scoops®)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.

Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat; cook and stir shallots in the hot butter until softened, about 2 minutes. Stir jalapeno peppers into shallots and cook until fragrant, about 2 more minutes. Stir cranberry jelly into the shallots and peppers until melted.

Mix shredded turkey with jalapeno-cranberry jelly mixture in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Arrange tortilla chips on the prepared baking sheet and fill each chip with 1 tablespoon turkey mix. Top each chip with 1/2 teaspoon of white Cheddar cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until the cheese topping is melted and the chips are golden, about 10 minutes.

video.description: Transform those Thanksgiving leftovers into something totally snackable with these awesome turkey nachos! Grab that leftover turkey and cranberry sauce and mix ‘em up with jalapenos and shallots and stuff a baking pan’s worth of crunchy scoop-style tortilla chips. Then top with plenty of Cheddar cheese and bake until everything is melty and tempting. You’ll make post-holiday snacking the best ever, whether you’re pleasing the kids or the relatives watching the game!
